entries.body: The flagship patch. The company says X39 uses its patented phototherapy to gently stimulate the skin with low levels of light, improving the flow of energy in the body. Stated benefits: supports improved exercise performance, strength and stamina, and overall health and well-being. No drugs or stimulants. Official use: one patch on clean, dry skin in the morning, worn up to 12 hours, stay hydrated. The official X39 sales sheet (SALES-X39-EN R02, Back Office) states the pack contains 30 patches. US retail $149.95 / Subscribe & Save $99.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave X39® Patches

entries.body: The performance patch, often paired with X39. The company says X49 promotes performance, strength and stamina, supports a healthy cardiovascular system through exercise, reduces recovery time following exercise, and supports maintaining a healthy weight through diet and exercise programs. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $149.95 / Subscribe & Save $99.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave X49™ Patches

entries.body: Bundle of the two flagship patches, X39 and X49, sold together at less than the combined single prices. The company combines X39's energy-flow and overall-health positioning with X49's performance, strength, stamina and recovery positioning. US retail $279.95 / Subscribe & Save $179.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: X39® & X49® Performance Bundle

entries.body: A countertop water system, not a patch. The company says X2O uses patented light-infusion technology, dual-stage filtration and hydrogen enrichment to produce 'Light-Infused Water' designed to support hydration, energy and wellness, and is designed to complement the patches and supplements. Filters: both stages are on a 6-month replacement cycle - primary up to 250 gallons, secondary up to 150 gallons (see the filter entries). US retail $5,995.00 / Subscribe & Save $5,495.00, with financing advertised from $250/month (checked 2026-10-17). Availability note from the official page at check date: state restrictions temporarily prevented purchase in California, Wisconsin and Iowa.
entries.title: LifeWave X₂O™: Light-Infused™ Water

entries.body: Replacement filter bundle for the X2O water system: the primary and secondary filters together. Both run on a 6-month replacement cycle (primary up to 250 gallons, secondary up to 150 gallons), so the pair is replaced on the same schedule. US retail $170.00 / Subscribe & Save $150.00 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave X₂O™ Filter Replacement Bundle

entries.body: Primary (first-stage) replacement filter for the X2O water system - the core of its contaminant-reduction system, designed to reduce a broad range of impurities found in municipal tap water. Official specs: 6-month replacement cycle, delivering optimal filtration for up to 6 months or 250 gallons of use; easy, tool-free installation. US retail $95.00 / Subscribe & Save $85.00 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave X₂O™ Primary Filter Replacement

entries.body: Secondary (final-stage) replacement filter for the X2O water system. The company says it enhances purified water by improving taste, clarity and texture while charging the water with molecular hydrogen, for antioxidant properties that help support the body's natural defenses. Official specs: 6-month replacement cycle, up to 6 months or 150 gallons of use; works with tap, spring, filtered, distilled and 'lite' water; easy, tool-free installation. US retail $85.00 / Subscribe & Save $75.00 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave X₂O™ Secondary Filter Replacement

entries.body: A daily system combining X39 patches with Cellergize Morning nutritional support. The company presents it as supporting stem cell activity (its marketing framing, tied to the CyanthOx ingredient in Cellergize Morning), cellular nutrition and resilience. US retail $229.90 / Subscribe & Save $169.90 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: Cellular Performance System

entries.body: A morning drink supplement (lemon and ginger flavored) blending essential vitamins, minerals and amino acids, with sea buckthorn fruit extract (CyanthOx). The company says its ingredients support healthy stem cell activity, overall health and wellness, and the health and vitality of human cells, and that it complements the patch line. The official Cellergize Morning booklet (LW0001 R03, Back Office) adds detail the store page does not carry: it groups ingredients by the support the company attributes to them - antioxidant support, support for the production of glutathione, support for copper-peptide formation (GHK-Cu and AHK-Cu), immune-function support, and prebiotic fiber for overall wellness - and states the product has no artificial sweeteners, flavors or colorings, is non-GMO and gluten free. Official use from the booklet: mix 2 scoops (13 g) with 16 fl oz (480 ml) of clean, filtered water, in the morning on an empty stomach or with food; one container is 30 servings; for adults 18 and over; once opened, use within 30 days. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.source_ref: https://www.lifewave.com/christinaditchkofsky/store/product/CELL-MORN-USA ; LifeWave Back Office — Cellergize Morning booklet, LW0001 R03, retrieved 2026-10-17
entries.title: Cellergize™ Morning

entries.body: The evening half of the company's daily supplement routine (sold singly and with Cellergize Morning as the Cellergize Duo). Per the official Duo page, Cellergize Evening is the 'Power Down. Rest Easy.' formula: made with ingredients chosen to complement a nighttime routine, support relaxation, and support a balanced lifestyle, alongside essential vitamins, minerals and amino acids - with no habit-forming stimulants or sedatives. Allergen note from the official page: Cellergize Evening contains soy (from nattokinase). US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: Cellergize™ Evening

entries.body: Bundle of Cellergize Morning and Cellergize Evening, the company's paired morning/evening supplement routine ('Your Daily Wellness Ritual' on the official page): a blend of essential vitamins, minerals and amino acids for targeted support from morning to night, with no habit-forming stimulants or sedatives, designed to pair with the non-transdermal patches. Allergen note: Cellergize Evening contains soy (from nattokinase). US retail $149.95 / Subscribe & Save $119.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: Cellergize™ Duo

entries.body: The relaxation patch in the Y-Age line. The company says Aeon helps you relax and helps you better manage or reduce stress. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Y-Age Aeon® Patches

entries.body: A Y-Age line patch named for the antioxidant glutathione. The company's stated benefits: improves the skin's appearance, helps promote relaxation and reduces stress, framed around a general state of health being the body's greatest defense. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17). Note: stronger numerical claims about glutathione levels circulate among distributors - those are distributor claims, not the company's store wording.
entries.title: LifeWave Y-Age Glutathione Patches

entries.body: A Y-Age line patch named for the amino-acid compound carnosine, positioned around movement. The company says it helps promote exercise and physical fitness as part of a wellness routine and improves overall state of wellness. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Y-Age Carnosine Patches

entries.body: Kit combining the three Y-Age patches: Aeon, Glutathione and Carnosine. US retail $209.85 / Subscribe & Save $149.85 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Y-Age System Kit

entries.body: A two-patch set (one white, one tan) positioned for targeted comfort. The company describes IceWave as fast-acting and non-addictive, convenient and easy to use. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave IceWave® Patches

entries.body: A two-patch set (one white, one tan) positioned around energy and fitness. The company says Energy Enhancer promotes the flow of energy in the body, supports overall wellness in combination with a healthy physical fitness routine, and supports your physical fitness routine. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Energy Enhancer® Patches

entries.body: The sleep patch. The company says Silent Nights works through relaxation: relaxation enhances quality of sleep and can improve length of sleep; described as a healthy sleep enhancer. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Silent Nights® Patches

entries.body: The skin patch in the Alavida line. The company says Alavida harnesses and balances the body's natural restorative energy to improve the healthy and radiant appearance of skin, and promotes the flow of energy in the body. No drugs or stimulants. Sold as part of the Alavida Regenerating System. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Alavida® Patches

entries.body: Nighttime facial creme in the Alavida skincare line. The company says Alavida Nightly Restore Facial Creme supports overnight protection of the skin to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, brighten complexion, and even out skin tone. Instructions: apply onto clean skin of face and neck; part of the Alavida Regenerating System. US retail $99.95 / Subscribe & Save $79.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Alavida® Nightly Restore Facial Creme

entries.body: Daytime facial nectar in the Alavida skincare line (full name: Alavida Daily Refresh Facial Nectar). The company says it supports protection of the skin while improving radiance and appearance with daily application. Instructions: apply onto clean skin of face and neck; part of the Alavida Regenerating System. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $59.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave Alavida® Facial Nectar

entries.body: Eye cream in the Alavida skincare line. The company describes it as a copper peptide-infused eye cream for all skin types, made to brighten complexion, improve the appearance of even skin tone, and support the appearance of firm skin. Size 15 mL / 0.5 oz. Instructions: use around the eye area in the morning and, if desired, at night. US retail $89.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: Alavida Revive Eye Cream

entries.body: The Alavida Regenerating Trio set: Alavida patches, Daily Refresh Facial Nectar and Nightly Restore Facial Creme sold together. Official use: one patch each night before bed, on clean, dry, unbroken skin, worn up to 12 hours; creme and nectar applied to clean skin of face and neck. The official Alavida booklet (ALVB-EN R03, Back Office) describes the wider Alavida Regenerating System as built on 98.6% naturally-derived, plant-based ingredients working as a day-and-night (24/7) approach, and names featured ingredients including GHK-Cu copper peptide, evening primrose oil and milk peptides. US retail $199.95 / Subscribe & Save $149.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.source_ref: https://www.lifewave.com/christinaditchkofsky/store/product/ALV-TRIO-USA-EN ; LifeWave Back Office — Alavida booklet, ALVB-EN R03, retrieved 2026-10-17
entries.title: LifeWave Alavida® Regenerating Trio

entries.body: The appetite patch. The company says SP6 Complete promotes a mindful approach to maintaining a healthy appetite, and that when combined with a healthy diet and exercise it encourages a general state of well-being and health. No drugs or stimulants. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave SP6 Complete® Patches

entries.body: Patches for HORSES ONLY. The company's official warning: AcuLife is intended for use on horses only, has not been tested on other animals, should not be used on any other animal, and should not be used on humans. It is a tan/white patch pair used with a small plastic bead, placed on either side of the area of concern on the horse. US retail $79.95 / Subscribe & Save $69.95 (checked 2026-10-17).
entries.title: LifeWave AcuLife® Patches

entries.body: Nirvana was a former mood-support patch in the LifeWave line. It is NOT in the current US store lineup (checked 2026-10-17). Older official pricing documents (2022) listed a 'Nirvana Mood Enhancer System' at $179.95 retail. Older materials and community discussions still reference it, which is why it appears in older content.
entries.title: LifeWave Nirvana (legacy product)

note: Current US lineup from the official LifeWave store (lifewave.com), checked 2026-10-17. Prices are US retail / Subscribe & Save in USD and change over time - re-verify each harvest. Benefit wording is the company's own positioning, summarized in our words. All patches are non-transdermal phototherapy patches: no drugs or stimulants, nothing enters the body, per the company. Company disclaimer on product pages: statements not evaluated by the FDA; products not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
